source: Derived from the unchanged right_gripper.json: T_E_M_aligned = T_E_M_original @ Q_original_aligned. Exchange thumb/index roles for both base and tip keypoints; keep the original midpoint and Y approach axis. Q is a proper 180-degree local-Y rotation, separate from the unchanged training S reflection.
axes: Aligned source analogue x=finger1/thumb base to finger2/index base (approximately -E.y), y=projected wrist-to-base-midpoint (approximately -E.z), z=cross(x,y) (approximately +E.x). X and Z are reversed relative to right_gripper.json; the midpoint and Y are unchanged.
verification_required: Candidate alignment, not a verified hardware calibration. Inspect midpoint, approach axis and physical finger assignment at multiple poses, then rerun policy dry-run with the new state. Restart client/test after switching profiles. Roll back with --tcp-geometry configs/xrpipe_xinhai/right_gripper.json.
